motor_contrasts.decision: Both original ES fields held. Generic conflicting actions can mean ICvsC relative to required response or two different observed movements, and does not specify which congruency term. Significance/printed d matching cannot select target.

sofer_coefficients.decision: Source beta notation and predictor centering do not establish requested unstandardized coefficients.452 has both linear and quadratic interactions under the shared descriptor; no numeric matching to choose. Other named-term p bounds confirmed.

cohen_thresholds.decision: Table2 analytic N40 explicitly summed by outcome; p<.05 for IQ and p<.10 for Socialization remain source-supported despite more precise abstract/narrative p values. No bound-precision false correction.

otto_coefficients.decision: Explicit mixed-effects logistic model and Table2 raw Estimates in log-odds units establish requested unstandardized b; standardized Stroop predictor does not turn these into fully standardized beta.

conceptual_replication.decision: Reviewer positively maps adapted native/non-native L1 factors from English/Tagalog to BP/Spanish. Holds all281–286 ES_r for requested standardized-beta versus raw binomial-logit mismatch, not merely because study languages differ.
